summary_en: Interim dividend per share raised to 16.50 yen from 13.00 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, with annual dividend increased to 36.50 yen from 33.00 yen. Increase reflects strong operational performance and improved productivity.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast for the Second Quarter of the Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Interim Period) (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Reiwa Accounting Holdings raised its interim dividend per share to 16.50 yen from the previously forecast 13.00 yen, with the annual dividend increasing to 36.50 yen from 33.00 yen. This increase follows an upward revision of interim earnings forecasts, driven by improved operational efficiency and faster project completion rates. The company operates with a core dividend payout ratio policy of 80%, to which it adds 1% to 10% annually in place of dividend equivalents for shareholder returns, resulting in total annual payout ratios of 81% to 90%.

For the interim period ending September 30, 2026, the company applied an 85% consolidated payout ratio, consisting of the 80% base distribution plus a 5% supplementary component. Management emphasized that replacing stock buyback programs and shareholder incentives with dividends ensures more equitable returns that are fully linked to share counts. The interim dividend increase reflects strong sales momentum and expanded profit margins, with interim operating profit forecast revised upward by 20.0% to 1,054 million yen from 878 million yen.
